## Today’s learning {#fv7-objective .fv-lesson .sphere-lesson }

```{=html}
<div class="objective"><h3>Lesson objective</h3><p>We are learning to use vector equations of spheres to solve geometric problems.</p><h3>Success criteria</h3><p>I can use a sphere’s equation to find its centre, radius and intersections.</p></div>
```

::: {.notes}
This single deck includes all eight examples and every subpart in booklet order. Allow approximately 65–75 minutes for full class working, or choose depth within a 50-minute period. A natural stopping point is after Example 3.28; do not impose a homework split. Recap and basic sphere equations 15 minutes; cross-sections and Examples 3.26–3.28 20; line intersections 15; diameter interpretation and Examples 3.30–3.31 20; finish 3. Students know $\lvert\underset{\sim}{r}-\underset{\sim}{c}\rvert=R$ for a circle, scalar products and vector lines. Solutions belong in OneNote and presenter notes.
:::
